quotes.text: // If you change these, you need to update kActionLogIds[]

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The action-constant comment points maintainers to kActionLogIds[] in nsMsgFilter::LogRuleHitGeneric. The actual logger indexes that array only after checking a nonnegative action type, array bounds and a nonempty entry. The source requires these two manually maintained representations to stay aligned; the comment does not enforce synchronization. The Fluent migration's removal of filter.properties does not remove the C++ mapping.
title: Filter action maintenance points to the checked C++ log-message array
